qa_gauntlet.degenerate_tris_note: all 104 are UV-sphere pole fans in the paw pads (main pad 24, toe pads 80) — zero-area pole triangles, render-harmless, fail the gauntlet geometry gate; fix is collapsing each pole ring to one vertex
qa_gauntlet.known_issue: FIXED 2026-11-12 (was: MIRROR DEFECT — mesh occupied the right-side envelope x = [-0.0045, +0.2005] with inward normals, skeleton correctly mirrored; pair was two right legs). Root cause was the geometry path mirroring twice (canonical-space mirror in build_leg_geometry/toe/pad placement, then cb() mirroring again). Fix: geometry now built in right-leg space for both sides, cb() mirrors exactly once, left-leg face order flipped to restore outward winding. Verified post-fix: L bbox x = [-0.2005, +0.0045] (exact mirror of R), normals mean-outward +0.0859 identical to R, weight rows sum to exactly 1.0, max 2 influences. Buggy GLBs preserved in work/originals/. Full record: DIGITIGRADE.md s.9. Remaining known issue is only the 104 pad degenerates (separate job).

socket_note: Scope divergence flagged in DIGITIGRADE.md s.5: PARTS_STANDARD socket 16 scopes leg.digi as a lower-leg/paw module (~0.28 m, anchored at Ankle_L + hock module, plantigrade thigh kept). This part is a FULL leg from the hip (0.898 m extent, own Hip_L root, pelvis skirt) — it implements the digitigrade chain end-to-end rather than swapping below a plantigrade thigh. Either the socket grows a full-leg variant or the thigh section is reference geometry for a future lower-leg-only cut.
